title: Urban trees key to building cooler, climate-resilient cities: Environment Ministry
byline: Urban trees play a vital role in creating cooler, safer and more climate-resilient cities by providing benefits that extend far beyond shade, the Environment Ministry said.

title: Rs. 500,000 only initial compensation for fallen prison officers: Spokesman
byline: The Department of Prisons said that the Rs. 500,000 paid to the families of prison officers who lost their lives in the recent clash at Negombo Prison was only an initial compensation payment.

title: Toronto active shooter incident leaves 5 people injured, 2 dead, police say
byline: Five people were injured and two were ​pronounced dead following an active shooter incident ‌in Toronto on Saturday, according to a police emergency alert on X.

title: Iran’s supreme leader pledges revenge for slain father and predecessor
byline: A written statement from Iran’s Supreme Leader Ayatollah Mojtaba Khamenei threatened vengeance for the death of his predecessor and father on Saturday, ​but added that it would depend not only on Iran but also ‌on ’’free people around the world’’.

title: Bellingham double fires England past Norway into World Cup semis
byline: Jude Bellingham scored twice, including the extra-time winner, as England ground out a 2-1 victory over a battling Norway side at Miami Stadium on Saturday to reach the World Cup semi-finals for the ​fourth time.

title: US launches fresh strikes as Iran closes Strait of Hormuz
byline: The US said it launched a fresh wave of strikes on Iran after Tehran struck a ship passing through the Strait of Hormuz.

title: Former Emir of Qatar Sheikh Hamad bin Khalifa Al Thani dies aged 74
byline: Qatar’s Father Emir ⁠Sheikh Hamad bin ⁠Khalifa Al Thani ‌has died at the age of ⁠74, the country’s Amiri ⁠Diwan said.

title: Argentina beat Switzerland to set up World Cup 2026 semifinal with England
byline: Defending champions Argentina will face England in the semifinals of FIFA World Cup 2026 after beating ten-man Switzerland 3-1 after extra time thanks to a decisive long-range effort by Julian Alvarez.

title: Viral World Cup bet: Norwegian swaps Instagram logo for British Airways after England win
byline: The playful, viral wagers were agreed before the July 12 clash as British Airways and Norwegian embraced the sporting rivalry online. Norwegian first challenged British Airways on Instagram, writing: “If Norway wins, you have to switch to our logo on Instagram on Sunday (one day). And vice versa. Deal?” British Airways confidently accepted, replying: “Don’t make bets you can’t win.”

title: China evacuates nearly two million people as powerful typhoon makes landfall
byline: A powerful typhoon has made landfall in China, the second to hit the country in a week, with nearly two million people evacuated from areas in the path of the storm.

title: Budget 2027 to be presented on November 12
byline: The Second Reading of the Appropriation Bill for the 2027 fiscal year is scheduled to be presented in Parliament on November 12.

title: Schools allowed to relax uniform rules to protect students from dengue
byline: The Ministry of Education has granted schools permission to allow students to wear clothing that offers better protection against mosquito bites as part of measures to safeguard children from dengue.

title: Sri Lanka ranked Asia’s most traffic-congested country
byline: Sri Lanka has been ranked the most traffic-congested country in Asia, according to the Numbeo Traffic Index by Country 2026 Mid-Year.

byline: Foreign Minister Vijitha Herath has expressed condolences on the passing of Qatar’s Father Amir, His Highness Sheikh Hamad bin Khalifa Al Thani.

title: Ukraine’s Zelenskiy dismisses Prime Minister Svyrydenko after only a year
byline: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskiy said on ​Sunday he planned to replace Prime Minister Yulia Svyrydenko after only a year in office, triggering the resignation ‌of the government.
